think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL docs. 2) Check whether the knob has one or more sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the behavior into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto/ignore), rather than just being an endpoint of the normal numeric scale. 3) Determine if setting that value changes the function (feature disabled/bypassed) versus merely changing magnitude. 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
